ticket: J8 (#1261): the owner, 2026-11-14: "add ALOT more images to the UI. especially on stuff you can do."
prompt:
Use only the two pictures attached to this message (ignore any earlier pictures). They are tile sheets already in this painted isometric golf game: match their style, scale, framing, camera angle, detail level and colours exactly.

Create an image, 4:3 landscape: a sheet of TWELVE tiny isometric dioramas in a 4 x 3 grid. Each scene sits on its own small slab of ground, on its own dark navy (#1E2A44) rounded square; the twelve squares are the same size, evenly spaced, and do not touch, on a flat charcoal (#1C1F26) background. Light from the upper right, soft shadows falling to the lower left, warm autumn colours, the year 1985 (no modern things). NO lettering, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere: every sign, board, paper, tag and screen is blank. No people. Each scene must be easy to tell apart from the others at a small size, with one clear main object. Row by row, left to right:
In scenes 1 to 6 the main object is ONE golf club lying on short grass with its HEAD large and near the viewer and a white ball beside it; make each club head clearly different. Row 1: (1) a driver: a very large round persimmon-wood head; (2) a fairway wood: a smaller, flatter wooden head with a brass sole plate; (3) a long iron: a thin, narrow steel blade; (4) a mid iron: a wider steel blade with grooves on its face.
Row 2: (5) a wedge: a broad, steeply angled steel head lying in a little sand; (6) a putter: a flat brass blade head on a smooth green beside a hole cup; (7) a trail of footprints across dewy grass leading to a golf ball lying in the fairway; (8) a golf ball resting right on the lip of the hole on a green, the flagstick lying on the grass beside it.
Row 3: (9) a thin bright white dotted ball trail flying in a bold arc over a blue pond to a green with a red flag; (10) a blank wooden fingerpost at a fork in a gravel path, one arm pointing toward a small clubhouse in the distance; (11) a beige 1985 computer keyboard with blank keys and a boxy two-button mouse on a wooden desk; (12) a closed timber gate held shut with a chain and a brass padlock, autumn leaves blown against it, a blank board hanging on it.
generator: ChatGPT image generation through the chatgpt-bridge (D:/AI/chatgpt-bridge), 2026-11-14
lighting: screen upper-right toward lower-left; soft shadows to the lower left; warm autumn colours; 1985
